title: B.Sc / M.Sc Mathematics | KSS KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSS Mathematics Krishna School of Science develops strong mathematical thinkers through conceptual depth, computational strength, and application-led learning. 0 Established 0 Years UG Duration (NEP) 0 Mission Priorities 0 Core Scope Areas LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSS Ms. Foram Shah Assistant Professor & HoD Mathematics foramshah.kss@kpgu.ac.in ABOUT DEPARTMENT Mathematics Learning With Research and Computation 01 The Department of Mathematics at KPGU was established in June 2020 with the objective of providing broad and strong mathematical knowledge through carefully chosen subject areas. It began with a 3-year B.Sc. Mathematics program under CBCS and later aligned with NEP-2020 to offer B.Sc. (Hons.) / B.Sc. (Hons. with Research) in Mathematics as a 4-year, 8-semester program. 02 The program blends conceptual and practical components to help students understand, analyze, and solve mathematical problems. It is designed to cultivate mathematical taste, research interest, and computational ability for tackling real-life challenges. 03 Alongside academics, the department promotes social awareness and holistic growth through NCC, NSS, social drives, plastic-free campus programs, blood donation camps, and educational field visits. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision Imparting of quality mathematics education and inculcating the spirit of logical reasoning, critical thinking and problem-solving ability through innovative teaching and research methodologies. The long-term vision of this department is to prepare qualified graduates who are equipped with deeper insight and research skills in the field of Mathematics. 01 To equip all of our students with the conceptual understanding, computational skills, and persistent disposition required to use quantitative reasoning and analysis effectively in their personal and professional lives. 02 To make student aware of technology to explore mathematical concepts through activities and experimentation. 03 To inculcate in students, the ability to apply mathematical and computational skills to model,formulate and solve real life applications. 04 To make the students capable of discharging professional,social and economic responsibilities ethically. 05 To provide platform to acquire abilities to evaluate problems using analytical/numerical/graphical techniques. 06 To achieve high standards of excellence in generating and propagating knowledge in Mathematics. Department is committed to providing an education that combines rigorous academics with joy of discovery. SCOPE OF PROGRAM Higher Study and Career Pathways 01 Higher studies in pure and applied sciences or management 02 Teaching careers in schools and institutes for competitive exams 03 Research and teaching careers in universities and colleges after PG/Doctoral study 04 Investment-banking pathways with mathematics plus management specialization 05 Data science, machine learning, analytics, and actuarial career opportunities FACULTY & STAFF Academic Team Ms. Foram Shah Assistant Professor & HoD Mathematics ⏱ Experience 11 years 6 months 🎓 Qualification Master of Science 🔬 Expertise Mathematics ✉ foramshah.kss@kpgu.ac.in FOCUS AREAS Academic Departments Biotechnology Explore → Chemistry Explore → Mathematics Explore → Microbiology Explore → Physics Explore → Drs.
